vadsrijk.npc.gids.begin.tekst: The Chonkdom is a world of its own, full of adventure. Your normal stuff stays safe at home; here you have your adventurer's inventory. Follow the golden ! and the story quests: they lead you through Camp Snuggle to Shroomsbury and beyond. Press J for your quest log. Stuck? Press U.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.driehoek.uitleg: Strong = x1.5 and 'Weak!'. The other way around = x0.7. Pink is strong against everything dechonked.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.elementen.tekst: Fire > Shroom > Slime > Fire: x1.5 damage on a weakness and x0.7 the other way around. Pink is extra strong against dechonked creatures. The icon in front of a creature's name (and on your weapon) is its element:  little flame = Fire,  leaf = Shroom (nature),  droplet = Slime (water),  heart = Pink. No icon = no element.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.flauw.tekst: If your Chonk drops to zero, you wake up at the nearest campfire you have lit (at a boss: at the arena door). You don't lose anything, you're just dizzy for 30 seconds.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.geheimen.tekst: Secrets are hidden all over the realm: ten lost plushies, five strange clues and hidden treasures. They sparkle a little when you're close. Who knows where the clues lead...
vadsrijk.npc.gids.kampvuren.tekst: In every area there are 2-3 campfires with a knight guh. Right-click: then it's your checkpoint. There's no fast travel; the airship takes you between Camp Snuggle and Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.klassen.tekst: Snuggle Knight (close up, sturdy), Fluff Hunter (from afar, nimble) and Chonk Mage (elements and healing). Each class has its own level. You switch in the Order temple of Shroomsbury. At level 17 you choose your specialization with the Grandmaster; at 35 and 58 you get a new title and power.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.loot.tekst: Gray (common), green (uncommon), blue (rare), purple (epic), orange (legendary) and pink (guhvine). Loot is personal. At a boss, everyone who helped enough gets their own chest.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.markt.tekst: Trade freely with other players, or put your loot in the auction house of Market Master Tap-Tap. Bound loot can't be traded.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.munten.tekst: Bronze, silver and gold with a little guh face. A hundred bronze is one silver, a hundred silver is one gold. They don't come along to the normal world.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.party.tekst: A group has at most five adventurers. You share xp and cheer-up progress when you're near each other, and you can never hurt each other. Bosses get stronger with more players in the arena.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.quests.tekst: Golden ! = story, yellow ! = side quest, ? = turn in or have a chat. You click through quest dialogues; cutscenes play by themselves. Your quest log (J) shows what you still need to do.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.rijdieren.tekst: In the Duskroot you choose your first mount: a Plumeguh. After that, Stable Master Hoofy, Ranger Moss and Knitter Woolwinter have more mounts for you, and the stable sells them too. Mounts have their own speed and jump and grow stronger along with you.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.statussen.tekst: Burning and Spored deal damage over time, Sticky slows you down, Stunned holds you in place for a moment. Team buffs: Wahoog (more damage), Snuggle Shield (absorbs hits) and Quickpaws (faster).
vadsrijk.npc.gids.sterren.tekst: The smith puts stars on your gear, with a little risk. He also repairs frayed gear. You can also have the bonuses rerolled.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.vaardigheden.tekst: Left-click is your normal attack; every weapon has its own attack speed (see the tooltip, the crosshair shows when you can strike again). R, V and G are your skills (they cost energy), Z is your ultimate skill: it charges up as you fight. C is the Snuggle Leap: a big leap forward, every class, without fall damage. You can set the keys yourself.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.vastzitten.tekst: Stuck in a pit, between rocks, in the water or somewhere you can't climb out of? Press U (Unstick; also /guhs vadsrijk vast) and stand still for 3 seconds. The snuggle wind then puts you on the nearest safe spot, or at your campfire if there's no spot nearby. You can do it once a minute, but not during a boss fight. You can change the key in Options > Controls > Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.weergave.tekst: Recruiter Pennant recommends it to everyone: play the Chonkdom with a render distance of 32 chunks, and at least 20 (Options > Video Settings > Render Distance). The Chonkdom is built by hand, without heavy world generation, so your render distance can usually go a lot higher here than in the Guhmension without stuttering. Then you can see the town, the giant shrooms and the dragon from far away.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z2_bevroren.tekst: Frozen is a status: you're slower, and heavy hits do extra damage. Stand by a campfire or wait until it thaws. You can freeze creatures too: then give them a good smack!
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z2_edelstenen.tekst: Some gear has 0, 1 or 2 sockets. Rough crystals from the mountains get set in them by Jewelerguh Glitter in Sugarbowl. Taking them out works too, and a gem never breaks.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z2_kristalwezens.tekst: In the mountains you fight real monsters: gray crystal without a heart. When defeated, they burst into shards that melt away. Mikas flee home in a puff of smoke. You never hurt guhs: you free petrified guhs with a click.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z2_reizen.tekst: Captain Polaris flies you from Sugarbowl back to the Harbor, and Pilotguh Zeppy flies you there again. Gondolaguh Cable takes you by gondola to the top of the Echo Slopes.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z2_splinterpieken.teks: After zone 1 and from level 20, Pilotguh Zeppy flies you from the Harbor to Sugarbowl, a warm little town inside a giant geode. Around it: the Echo Slopes (east, lv 20-23), the Frozen Snuggle Lake (west, lv 23-26), the Splinter Gorge (north, lv 26-29) and the Mirror Keep (lv 28-30).
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z2_titel.tekst: At level 30 a third title from the Snuggle Order awaits you, with Order Master Crystalline in the Crystal Chapel of Sugarbowl: Crystal Champion, Polestar Falcon or Crystal Oracle.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z3_lantaarn.tekst: In the Rootdark and the Heart of the Tree it's pitch black. Creatures outside the light are dark silhouettes and take half damage. Your Nest Lantern, pink veins and lit cave lanterns give light. Together you see more.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z3_pluimguh.tekst: With Stable Master Feathers in the Plume Stable you choose your first mount: a Plumeguh. Call it with X, open your mount screen with N. From up high you can glide down with your Plumeguh; going up works with stairs, lifts and the blossom wind. When you attack or a boss hits you, you dismount.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z3_premiebord.tekst: In the Hunters' Hut of Honeybough hangs the bounty board of Hunterguh Turnip: new jobs every day for level 40-50. Hunting, gathering, delivering, clearing mold. No rush, no leaderboard: do whatever you enjoy.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z3_reizen.tekst: Captain Buzzsail flies you from the mast of Honeybough to the Harbor or Sugarbowl. In the tree: the bridle path winds around the outside of the trunk from the ground via Honeybough up to canopy 1; inside, the inner stairs of Barkton run up to the nest. The Honey Lift goes from the ground (Mossfoot) to Honeybough, the Canopy Lift from Honeybough to canopy 1, and the pink wind columns blow you from the branches to canopy 1, 2 and 3. You glide down with your Plumeguh.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z3_schemerwortel.tekst: After the Splinter Peaks and from level 30, the airship flies you to Honeybough, a beekeepers' town like a ring around a tree as big as a mountain. The tree has 4 layers: at the top the Canopy Sea (3 canopy floors, lv 30-34) with the nest, then the Branchways with the beekeeper villages (lv 34-38) and Honeybough, in the hollow trunk Barkton (lv 40-43), and under the trunk the Rootdark (lv 46-49). On the ground around the tree lie the Root Fields (lv 43-46). The Cheese Zeppelin Yard is on an island of its own.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z3_titel.tekst: At class level 50 a fourth title from the Snuggle Order awaits you, with Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel of Honeybough: Nest Warden, Canopy Falcon or Dusk Sage.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z4_knuffeltij.tekst: Once a year, plushies from all over the world wash up on Snuggletide Beach. This year they're gray: they come from the empire. Just go there: you'll cheer them up and they'll tell you their story.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z4_lampionkust.tekst: After the Duskroot and from level 50 you fly to Lanternhaven, a harbor town on stilts by a pink sea. The Lantern Coast is a string of little islands (lv 50-56): Snuggletide Beach, Beach Party Island, Flower Island, Coral Bay, Kite Island, Lighthouse Island, the giant turtle, Mystery Island in the mist and the Pierhead with the Liftoff Pier. Above the sea floats Highchonk on Mother Cloudwhale. It's peaceful here: lots to do, little to fight.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z4_reizen.tekst: Skyportguh Weathervane in Lanternhaven has the travel map: back to the Tree and the other islands. Between the little islands you sail your own little sailboat. The airship to Highchonk only departs from the Liftoff Pier, all the way in the east.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z4_zeilboot.tekst: From Boatguh Saily at the northern pier of Lanternhaven you get your very own guh sailboat. With it you sail freely between the little islands. At the edge of the sea the Ring Current gently turns you back.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z5_ambachten.tekst: Highchonk is the capital of all crafts. In the Crafters' Guild next to the university you'll find the mentors of cooking, brewing, smithing, sewing and beekeeping. The Masterworks are coming soon.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z5_hoogvads.tekst: After the Lantern Coast and from level 55, the first airship sails up from the Liftoff Pier to Highchonk, the capital of all guhs, on the back of Mother Cloudwhale (lv 56-60). It's safe here: no monsters in the city. The Skyport is on the north flank, Gentleheart Lane runs from the cathedral (west) to the palace (east), the university is in the north, the Cloudwatch Academy in the south, Tail Park all the way east and the Eye Garden in the west.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z5_reizen.tekst: Harbormaster Weathervane at the Skyport flies you to all the islands of the Island Sea: click on him for the travel map. After the story of Highchonk, line E to the Silklands (zone 6) opens, from Tail Harbor.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z5_soepkeuken.tekst: In the Great Soup Kitchen the Unchonked get to eat chonky again: skinny guhs who fled from the east. The further the story goes, the fuller and happier they get. Help Cook Ladle, and listen to their stories.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z5_speuren.tekst: In 'Treason in the City' you're a detective. Question suspects (choose your questions well: one question turns up a clue), search for clues at the places the tracker points to, and check the evidence board: with Inspector Snoop in the Council Hall or with your Detective's Notebook (right-click). A wrong accusation costs nothing: the board explains why it doesn't add up.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z6_bakens.tekst: Five beacons show the caravans the way to the Mother Oasis. At a beacon you connect the constellation: follow the stars in the order of the hint. A wrong star? No problem: you just start over. During the day the Star Lens shows you the night sky. Right-click the lens to see how many beacons are already lit.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z6_rijdieren.tekst: In the Silklands you get two new mounts. The humpguh (from Stable Master Bumpy, in 'Granny Date's Caravan') is fast on sand and has two seats. The flying carpet (Carpet Weaver Button, 'A Carpet of Starsilk') floats over sand and water and glides on a bit when you stop.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z6_steden.tekst: In both cities you'll find a banker, a Quartermaster (to the Snuggle Quarter), a Squad Board (Snuggle Squads) and campfires. In the Grand Bazaar of Saffron Gate you'll find the merchants and the mentors of smithing and sewing; you learn cooking in the Caravanserai, brewing under the Observatory and beekeeping in the Paradise Garden.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z6_toren.tekst: At the end of 'The Star Caravan', Duchess Ringaling seals her tower with a ring lock. That finishes the story of the Silklands. The tower itself is a raid for 2 to 10 players: that's where the real final boss awaits.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z6_zijdeland.tekst: After Highchonk and from level 60, line E flies from Highchonk Tail Harbor to the Rose Gorge Skyport, on the west coast of the Great Mainland (lv 60-70). The Silklands have two cities: Rose Gorge (the gorge city, arrival) and Saffron Gate (the capital on the river), and five areas: the Pink Dunes (60-62), the Palm Gorges (62-64), the Salt Flats (64-66), Ruin Valley (66-68) and the Mother Oasis (68-70).

vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_waterval_2: by the middle waterfall of the Palm Gorges, behind the curtain of water
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_waterval_3: by the top waterfall of the Palm Gorges, under the Palm Beacon

vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_zoutvlakte: on the white Salt Flats, southeast of Saffron Gate

vadsrijk.npc.quiz.fout: Almost! Remember the triangle: FIRE > SHROOM > SLIME > FIRE. Try again!
vadsrijk.npc.quiz.vraag.slijm: Pop quiz! A grumpy Blob is of the Slime element. What do you bonk it with hardest?
vadsrijk.npc.quiz.vraag.vuur: Pop quiz! A creature with a little flame next to its health bar is of the Fire element. What do you bonk it with hardest?
vadsrijk.npc.quiz.vraag.zwam: Pop quiz! An angry Bobblecap is of the Shroom element. What do you bonk it with hardest?

vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.hoogvads: Highchonk is still floating too high. First Mother Cloudwhale has to sink low over the sea (the Lantern Coast story), and you need to be at least level 55. You are level %s now.
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.hoogvads.kort: After the Lantern Coast, from level 55
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.kandijkom_level: Brrr, the Splinter Peaks are ice cold and dangerous. Come back when you're level 20 (now level %s).
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.kandijkom_level.k: Not discovered yet. From level 20 (you: level %s).
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.kandijkom_verhaal: Sugarbowl? I'll only fly there once this land's story is finished. Help Grandmaster Chonkfoot in Shroomsbury first.
Not discovered yet. Finish the Shroomsbury story first.
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.lampionkust_level: The Lantern Coast is for adventurers from level 50. You're level %s. A little more practice!
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.lampionkust_verha: The Lantern Coast? First the Duskroot has to bloom again. Help the dragon, knight!
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.schemerwortel_lev: Real monsters live in that tree, recruit. Come back when you're level 30 (now level %s).
Not discovered yet. From level 30 (you: level %s).
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.schemerwortel_ver: That giant tree in the east? I'll only fly there once the Splinter Peaks are safe. Help Sugarbowl first.
Not discovered yet. Finish the Splinter Peaks story first.
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.zijdeland: Line E to the Silklands only opens once Mother Cloudwhale has swum east (after 'Stars in the East' in Highchonk) and you're level 60 (you: level %s).
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.zwamzoet: Not yet, recruit! First Camp Snuggle has to be safe. Follow Sergeant Fluffball and the camp's story (your tracker at the top right), then I'll fly you to Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.zwamzoet.kort: Not discovered yet. The Camp Snuggle story will bring you here.
vadsrijk.npc.reiskaart.uitleg: Hold the mouse button and drag to move the map. Click a destination to fly there.
vadsrijk.npc.rijdier.later: Hoofy has reserved your Cloud Lamb for you!
vadsrijk.npc.rijdierquest.hert.open_plek: The little hoofprints stop at a clearing full of lightshrooms. It's very quiet here.
Among the shrooms stands a deer, as soft as a plushie. It looks at you with big, wet eyes.
Carefully it comes closer and sniffs your hand. Then it walks along with you. Bring the news to Ranger Moss!
vadsrijk.npc.rijdierquest.hert.sporen.0: The third lantern glows up warmly. The whole forest goes quiet for a moment...
vadsrijk.npc.rijdierquest.hert.sporen.1: There! Tiny pink hoofprints glitter in the moss, one by one, heading west. Go on, follow them.
vadsrijk.npc.rijdierquest.teaser.rijdier: Oh, your very own Cloud Lamb... that's only possible once you've ridden a mount before. Come back when you have your own Plumeguh, nyeg!
When the lanterns in the Sporewood are lit, a very soft deer sometimes comes to look... But it only trusts someone who has ridden a mount before. Come back when you have your own Plumeguh, nyeg!
vadsrijk.npc.rijdierquest.teaser.z2_rijd: Hear that? Somewhere in the Splinter Gorge something small is howling... But a little wolf like that only goes with someone who has ridden a mount before. Come back when you have your own Plumeguh, nyeg!
There, behind a block of ice at the bottom of the gorge: a teeny-tiny snow wolf pup, with a snowflake on its nose. It's shivering.
The pup crawls straight into your hood. It's as light as a little pillow and squeaks softly.
Grumpy creatures are sniffing all around you. Cheer them up, and the pup can safely come along to Knitter Woolwinter in Sugarbowl.
vadsrijk.npc.rol.klasse.kies: Which path do you choose? You can always switch later at the great Order temple in Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.npc.rol.luchtschip.nog_niet: Finish your training first, recruit! Then I'll fly you anywhere. Well, to Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.npc.rol.luchtschip.vraag: Climbing aboard? The airship is ready. Wind force: chonky, visibility: wahoog!
vadsrijk.npc.rol.luchtschip_kamp.vraag: Back to Camp Snuggle? Say hi to the Camp Blob for me!
vadsrijk.npc.rol.nog_niet: %s isn't here yet (that comes with another part of the Chonkdom).
vadsrijk.npc.rol.questbord.leeg: The quest board is empty! Everyone in Shroomsbury has been helped. Or you need to get a bit stronger first.
vadsrijk.npc.scene.einde.onder: Wahoognir circles on. And somewhere, the Mikas are laughing up their paws.
vadsrijk.npc.scene.stad.onder: The city of the Snuggle Order
vadsrijk.npc.schat.hoedenschat: High up on a lonely shroom cap in the Sporewood, at the end of a narrow plank path. Who built this little hut here?
vadsrijk.npc.schat.kristalkamer: Among the glowing crystals lies something very special.
vadsrijk.npc.schat.schildpad: All the way out on faraway Turtle Island. How did you get here? Swimming? Wahoog!
vadsrijk.npc.schat.slaapheuvel: Deep inside the sleeping giant slime hill, where it softly snores. Sticky, but worth it!
vadsrijk.npc.schat.vuurtorenkelder: Under the lighthouse of Camp Snuggle. Someone once hid a little chest here.
vadsrijk.npc.schat.waterval: Behind the curtain of water lies a forgotten treasure chest of the Order!
vadsrijk.npc.spion.dialoog.0: Akim. I found black fluff under your stall. Paw prints. A disguise. Scratches. And your lookout post.
vadsrijk.npc.spion.dialoog.1: Nyeg?? That... that's all a coincidence! I'm a normal guh! I love cheese! And...
vadsrijk.npc.spion.dialoog.2: ...MEOW. Uh. I mean: CHONK. Chonk chonk.
vadsrijk.npc.spion.dialoog.4: NEVER! You'll never catch me! The boss will hear what you've done! To the rooftops!
vadsrijk.npc.spion.later: (The fight on the rooftops of Shroomsbury comes with the bosses of the Chonkdom.)
vadsrijk.npc.spion.onder: Akim the Cheese Guh was a Mika!
vadsrijk.npc.spion.weet_het: All five clues point the same way: to Akim the Cheese Guh at the market. Go unmask him!
vadsrijk.npc.stap.level.tip: Cheer up creatures in %s, or help the guhs in Shroomsbury with their side quests.
vadsrijk.npc.stap.luchtschip: %s. Take the airship first: talk to %s, %s.
vadsrijk.npc.stap.z2_poort: %s. First get out of the Sugarbowl geode: %s.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.elementen: Fire beats shroom, shroom beats slime, slime beats fire (x1.5). Pink is strong against everything dechonked. The colored icon in front of a creature's name tells its element.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.flauw: No worries: you don't lose anything. You wake up at the nearest campfire you have lit and feel a little dizzy for 30 seconds.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.kampvuur: Right-click a campfire: that's where you wake up if you faint. It also refills your Chonk and energy.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.levelop: You've grown stronger and earned a skill point. Spend it in your skill tree at the Order temple.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.loot: The color of the light beam tells you how rare something is: gray, green, blue, purple, orange and very rarely pink (Guhvine!). Loot is yours alone: nobody else can take it.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.markt: At the auction house you buy and sell loot with Chonk Coins. Bound loot stays with you.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.party: In a group of up to five you share xp nearby, count together for cheer-up quests and never hurt each other. /guhs vadsrijk party uitnodigen <naam>.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.quests: Your next step is always at the top right: what, with whom and where, with a little arrow. A pink light beam marks the spot. Press J for your quest log. A ! above a guh is a new quest, a ? means: turn in here or have a chat.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.skill: Press R, V or G for your skills and Z for your ultimate skill. They cost energy and have a short cooldown. You can see them at the bottom in your bar.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.skillboom: With skill points you pick variants of your skills and handy passives. Re-picking is free, once per hour.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.sterren: At the smith you put stars on your gear. Exciting: sometimes a star falls off, and very rarely something gets frayed. Frayed is never forever: the smith hammers it smooth again.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.weergave: The Chonkdom is built by hand, without heavy world generation. Set your render distance to 32 chunks (at least 20): here that usually works without stuttering, and the views are worth it. Options > Video Settings.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z2_bevroren: You're frozen: slower, and heavy hits hurt extra. Get out of the cold for a bit, or wait until you thaw.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z2_edelsteen: Set rough crystals into the sockets of your gear at Jewelerguh Glitter in Sugarbowl.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z2_kristal: These creatures are real monsters. When defeated, they burst into shards. Watch out for Splinterlings: they shoot shards when you hit them.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z2_versteend: A petrified guh is made of gray crystal, but still alive. Click it when your quest asks you to: that sets it free. You never hurt guhs.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z3_lantaarn: Stay in the light. Outside the light, creatures are silhouettes and your hits do half the damage.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z3_monsters: The creatures in the tree are real monsters. Just defeat them. You never hurt guhs.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z3_zweef: On your Plumeguh you can glide down from high places. Jump off the glide platform or a balcony of the Bridle Path and hold the jump key.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z4_boot: Your little sailboat is moored at the pier. Sail it to all the little islands. Snuggletide Beach is southeast of Lanternhaven.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z4_knuffel: Walk up to the gray fluff: that cheers up the plushie and it tells its story.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z4_opvrolijken: The creatures on the Lantern Coast are gray and sad. Defeat them and they go poof in pink: then they're happy again. You never hurt guhs.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z5_bord: Right-click your Detective's Notebook to open the evidence board: all clues and suspects at a glance.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z5_veilig: Highchonk is safe: no monsters attack in the city. Campfires still work as rest spots.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z5_verhoor: In an interrogation you choose your questions. One question gives you a clue for your Detective's Notebook. You may ask anything.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z6_lens: Right-click the Star Lens: you see how many beacons are already burning and where the next one is.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z6_puzzel: Read the hint carefully: it tells you in which order to connect the stars. Wrong? Then you start over.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z6_veilig: Rose Gorge and Saffron Gate are safe: no monsters attack in the cities. Campfires work as rest spots.
vadsrijk.npc.volg.straal_aan: Light beam above your goal: on
vadsrijk.npc.volg.straal_uit: Light beam above your goal: off
vadsrijk.npc.werver.eerst_praten: The portal is still asleep... Talk to Recruiter Pennant first, here by the temple. He's already waving at you!
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.0: Halt! Nyeg, don't be scared. I'm Recruiter Pennant, of the Snuggle Order. And you... you have just the right ears.
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.2: To become an adventurer! Beyond this old portal lies the Chonkdom. Creatures there turn gray and grumpy: the Chonklessness. The Order is looking for recruits to cuddle them happy again. With a pillow. Or an arrow. Or a fireball. Very lovingly.
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.3: You get a class, skills, quests, colorful loot, an airship... ...Nyeg. Why are you looking at me like that? Do you also feel like you've seen this before? Something called 'Wynn'-whatsit?
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.4: Nope. This is tooootally different. There are plushies here! And the monsters get happy instead of dead. Totally different. Really.
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.5: One more piece of advice, recruit: set your render distance to 32 chunks, and at least 20 (Options > Video Settings). The Chonkdom is built by hand, without heavy world generation. It can usually go much higher there than here in the Guhmension without stuttering. And the views! Wahoog!
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.7: Then you step through the portal. It's still asleep, but for a recruit of the Order it'll wake up. Your own things stay safe here. Tell Sergeant Fluffball that Pennant sent you!
vadsrijk.npc.werver.weer: There's my recruit again! The portal is ready. And remember your render distance: 32 chunks, at least 20!
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.onbekend: The Order knows very little about this creature yet. Cheer up a few more!
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_baas_koning_klodde: King Blob, the world boss of the Blob Meadow. Splits into three colors that you have to cheer up together.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_baas_mika_spion: A Mika disguised as a market guh. Sunglasses, straw hat, fake mustache. Meows when he's nervous.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_baas_opperzwam: The Overshroom, the old guardian of the Shroom Temple. Unchonked by a Mika pin.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_klodderreus: The Gray Blob Giant: a clump of black fluff from the dragon that fell into the camp pond. Once cheered up, he became the Camp Blob of Camp Snuggle.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_mob_bubbelklodder: Blows bubbles when he's angry. The bubbles stick. Cheered up, he blows heart bubbles.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_mob_druipslijm: Drips from the ceiling of the Drip Caves. Look up!
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_mob_glimzwam: A glowing shroom deep in the caves. Its light turns gray when it's angry.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_mob_hoedjesbol: A little shroom with a hat that's too big. He loses it when he cheers up again.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_mob_klodder: An ordinary blob from the Blob Meadow. Unchonked, he's gray and grumpy; cheered up, he bounces in his own color again. Loves to eat balls of wool.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_mob_kloddertje: A teeny little blob. Often comes in a whole bunch, or out of a Mother Blob.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_mob_knaag: A little rodent that nibbled on gray fluff. He really shouldn't have.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_mob_kristalklodder: A blob full of crystals. Sparkles beautifully, and is very proud of it.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_mob_moederklodder: An elite: a big blob with little ones all around. Snores terribly loudly at night.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_mob_mosgeest: A floating tuft of moss with little eyes. Unchonked, he whispers gray things; cheered up, he hums.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_mob_sporenpriester: The Overshroom's priest. Blesses his friends and curses you a little.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_mob_sporenpuffer: Sneezes little spore clouds. Spored! Get out of the cloud and keep fighting.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_mob_stuiterklodder: Bounces. Always. Even when he's asleep. Watch where he's going to land.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_mob_tempelridder: A knight of the Shroom Temple. Wears a cap as a helmet and a stem as a lance.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_mob_zwamwachter: The guardian of the Sporewood. Sturdy, slow, and actually very shy.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_proefklodder: A practice blob of the Order. He doesn't mind.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_z2_boormeester: The Mika Drill Master and his machine with three drill heads. Make them overheat in the right order.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_z2_galmvleermuis: Turns invisible and can only be heard. Listen for the fluttering!
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_z2_galmwolf: The Echo Wolf, world boss of the Echo Slopes. Howls crystal waves: take cover behind the frozen pillars.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_z2_ijzelgeest: A floating ice spirit that makes the ground freeze. Loves to steal mittens.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_z2_mika_mijnwerker: A Mika with a little helmet and a drill. When defeated, he flees to his fort in a puff of smoke.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_z2_spiegelzucht: Lady Mirrorsigh, lady of the Mirror Keep. Only the reflection without a shadow is real.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_z2_splinterling: A crystal golem of gray crystal. With every hit he shoots shards around. When defeated, he bursts apart.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.zonepoort.tekst: To the next zone? Finish the main story AND explore at least 75% of the zone in your Exploring Book (key B): viewpoints, campfires, secrets, side quests and more. The captain and the travel map show what you still miss. Your highest level is the level of the highest zone you have been to + 5 (25 if you never went to zone 2). Extra xp is saved up and paid out double later.
